structured.answer: I'd buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) index fund through a Pesagot securities account, 750 ₪ a month. The page says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ after 15 years (135,000 ₪ of it is what I put in). That's in today's money, assuming 2% inflation a year, 7% return and the dollar staying at 3.17 ₪.
